data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Tokenomics of Agent-to-User Grilling in Chatbot Scenarios — Uncertainty Collapse, Cognitive Labor Substitution, and Optimal Elicitation
data.description: Mathematical and architectural best-practice framework for Agent-to-User Grilling in enterprise chatbots on Google Cloud, formalizing super-linear uncertainty scaling (gamma > 1), human cognitive labor vs. machine token substitution (MRTS_{L,M}), EVSI optimal stopping rules, and ADK 2.0 bounded elicitation patterns.
